correctness.rationale: The exact affine parametrization vvᵀ (v=(1,w)) turns Fourier eigenvalues into complete quadratic Gauss sums ψ(a)∑_w ψ(Q(w)+L(w)), with coordinate pairing essential in characteristic two. Squaring and summing gives q^d times a radical character sum, hence singular values 0 or q^(d−r/2); for each quadratic Q exactly q^r compatible affine L forms. Symmetric-bilinear rank census (odd q) and alternating-polar rank census with free squares (even q) prove all claimed multiplicities and nullity. Euler product identities and rapidly decaying radical nullity tails yield q/(q+1) odd q and two distinct (1±A_q O_q)/2 even-q parity limits. Independent small-q direct character enumeration reproduced q=2 d1/2/3 band counts; frozen verify_stdlib.py was inspected for extension-field checks.
